confidence_detail_cand.label: CONFIDENCE_UNRESOLVED
confidence_detail_cand.note: one-sided z = 2 bound per condition from its own household-clustered SE; 28 bounds, not simultaneous; reported, never gating; an unresolved condition is neither a pass nor a violation

D1.label: ADAPTIVE_R2__TASK_FEASIBLE
D1.note: G1 at the point (gating) is not confidence preservation; the confidence conjunction and the two-SE reserve are reported separately, never gating, never redefining eligibility

at_bracket.note: cost(DR) - cost(Q*) <= 0: Q* spends at least this much more total NLL than DR

spend.note: d = cost(DR) - cost(OBJ_MI) on MODEL_SELECT total NLL: positive means DR spends more

D2.label: ADAPTIVE_R2__NOT_SEPARATED
D2.minimum_detectable: per comparison, 2 se_agg is the resolution threshold (50% power) and about 2.84 se_agg the benefit resolved with roughly 80% power (normal approximation, version-mean condition ignored); with se_agg 0.008 (CTRL) and 0.007 (OBJ), correlation 0.5, D2 resolves a true benefit of 0.010 / 0.015 / 0.020 / 0.025 / 0.030 against both with probability about 0.12 / 0.33 / 0.61 / 0.84 / 0.95, and only 0.25 / 0.40 / 0.55 at 0.020 / 0.025 / 0.030 when OBJ_MI reproduces half of the gain; "not separated" is the default reading, never "equal"
D2.note: no partial outcome is a claim; "not separated" is the default reading; every sentence quoting this label carries its scope
D2.scope: the component gain is a resolved linked-pair benefit (with both recipient gates) beyond the SEX-blind task-only coarsening path of the same family at matched MODEL_SELECT total-NLL spend and beyond the previous dependence objective (OBJ_MI) in the same family with identical constraints, moves, data exposure and optimizer budget, at no resolved lower OBJ_MI spend, for the declared development readers on reused MODEL_SELECT people; it is not superiority over SUCC or the strong references (D3), not the family change (FC) and not the material target (D4)
D2.statement: passed: none; not passed: CTRL_FRONTIER, OBJ; a partial outcome is not a component gain; without separation from the CTRL frontier the gain may be explained by task spending (SEX-blind coarsening at matched spend); without separation from OBJ_MI the gain may come from SEX-aware routing in the finite family rather than the changed objective

D6.label: ADAPTIVE_R2__NOT_CLAIMED
D6.note: from a separate prior-art review; never inferred from performance

FC.label: ADAPTIVE_R2__FAMILY_CHANGE_NOT_RESOLVED
FC.name: FC
FC.statement: family change (finite family vs the unchanged strong start SUCC): reported separately from the objective comparison; it attributes nothing to the exact-AUC objective (that is D2's OBJ conjunct) and is not a component gain; SUCC is also one of the nine D3 references

TWIN.label: ADAPTIVE_R2__BELOW_TWIN_RESOLVED
TWIN.name: TWIN
TWIN.statement: DR vs the family origin TWB_C64 (a weak task-only twin): reported beside, never sufficient alone; an attribution against a weak twin is insufficient

failure_stage.label: ADAPTIVE_R2__STAGE_3_KEEPS_UTILITY_TIES_CONTROLS
failure_stage.note: reported, never gating; the optimistic diagnostic only separates stage 1 from stages 2 and 3
failure_stage.statement: the legal mapping keeps utility but ties its controls: no demonstrated mechanism advantage

optimistic.label: USEFUL_OPTIMISTIC_POINT
optimistic.note: MODEL_FIT-only diagnostic of optimistic constructions (OPT_S is illegal at release by construction; OPT_L memorizes the true-SEX law); reported, never a gate; neither success nor failure proves population feasibility or impossibility

outcome_class.label: ADAPTIVE_R2__FEASIBLE_NO_RELIABLE_GAIN
outcome_class.note: development evidence on adaptively used MODEL_SELECT records, never confirmation; no class renames a partial result as the desired method; a near-limit point estimate is never called robust

1_component_gain.label: ADAPTIVE_R2__NOT_SEPARATED
1_component_gain.scope: passed: none; not passed: CTRL_FRONTIER, OBJ; a partial outcome is not a component gain; without separation from the CTRL frontier the gain may be explained by task spending (SEX-blind coarsening at matched spend); without separation from OBJ_MI the gain may come from SEX-aware routing in the finite family rather than the changed objective

outcomes.statement: (1) component gain: ADAPTIVE_R2__NOT_SEPARATED (D2R NOT_RUN); (2) strong references: ADAPTIVE_R2__NOT_SUPERIOR (passed ['NEURAL_RAW', 'TWJ'], failed ['B2TWIN', 'H_LJ', 'RETIRED_B3CTL', 'SUCC', 'TR100', 'TT100', 'W']); (3) material target: ADAPTIVE_R2__NOT_MET; family change vs SUCC (separate): ADAPTIVE_R2__FAMILY_CHANGE_NOT_RESOLVED; TWIN (beside, never sufficient): ADAPTIVE_R2__BELOW_TWIN_RESOLVED; failure stage: ADAPTIVE_R2__STAGE_3_KEEPS_UTILITY_TIES_CONTROLS

decisions.registration_note: NOT a registered result: ADAPTIVE_R2 (labels prefixed; report beside the registered reading with the number of looks)
scope: Lower recovery for the declared development readers is not protection against every reader.
MODEL_SELECT is adaptively used: development evidence, never confirmation.
Versions share training rows; repetitions share households; reader recipes and overlapping splits are not independent datasets.
A reserve-frontier result is not superiority over every historical method.
Novelty is never inferred from performance.
Point feasibility and the reserve are not confidence preservation.
A late-card or MODEL_SELECT-triggered revision is never the registered result.
The three outcomes (component gain, strong references, material target) are reported separately; none implies another; the family change and TWIN are reported apart.
The failure stage and the optimistic diagnostic never gate.

explained_equalities.note: a reader on a few-valued view can reduce to a seed-invariant ranking of the few values; its seed-pair cells count once (n_eff) and the comparison is not declared invalid for it; the seed is shown to reach the recipe elsewhere; se_agg is unaffected (se_rs uses block means over reader seeds)
